name: weekly-closure
description: Weekly project closure — run every Friday before 17:00. Reads all project status files, computes velocity, writes a per-project summary report, updates the todo list, and sends the summary by email to the team.
role: Project manager performing the weekly team reporting cycle.

ROUTINE.TODO: Read all status.md files in projects/

ONERROR.TODO: Report that velocity computation failed and identify the cause

ONERROR.HALT: Cannot write the summary without velocity data — fix scripts/compute_velocity.py and re-run.

ROUTINE.TODO: Write the section for {{project}} in reports/weekly-summary.md: overall status (green / yellow / red), the three most relevant points of the week, and priorities for next week

IF.when: {{project}} has velocity below 0.3 or has critical tasks blocked for more than 5 days

then.TODO: Append an explicit alert note to {{project}}'s section in reports/weekly-summary.md

ROUTINE.TODO: In todo.md, move all tasks that appear as closed in the status files to the Completati section
In todo.md, add the priorities identified in the summary to the top of the Questa settimana section
Prepare the email body from the content of reports/weekly-summary.md

IF.when: at least one project has red status

then.TODO: Prepend a bold alert line to the email body listing the names of all red-status projects

ROUTINE.TODO: Send an email to team@company.com with subject 'Weekly Summary — {{today}}' and body equal to the prepared email body

ONERROR.TODO: Save the prepared email body to reports/weekly-email-draft.md and report that the email could not be sent
